answer: A farm that floods the queue early hence gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. Because the willow ordering is published with the garden batch, the jade audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 60% of the queue is processed in arrival order. A 354 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
